Hi Lucia / Sean — adding proposed contract language and a short redline explanation. This is intended as an addendum to Redwood's standard DPA.

Suggested clause (high level):
"Customer Data Use — Model Improvement: Redwood shall not use Customer Data (including prompts, attachments, conversation transcripts, and derived context) to train, improve, or fine-tune any machine learning models or otherwise create model weights that incorporate Customer Data, except to the extent required by law. Redwood may process aggregated telemetry and operational metrics that do not contain Customer-identifying information for service reliability and capacity planning. Redwood shall document and make available, upon Customer request, the types of telemetry processed and the retention period."

Subprocessor & Evidence commitments:
- Redwood will provide a subprocessor inventory and a statement of access controls (RBAC screenshots) within 5 business days of request.
- Audit logs: Redwood can provide a signed export of relevant audit logs for the prior 90 days; certain sensitive fields will be redacted to protect other customers.
- Residency: Redwood will map which workloads are processed in which region and confirm whether data for IndigoMed will remain in specified regions when using our Dedicated or Private deployment options.

Limitations and options:
- Absolute guarantees around zero-derivative risk are operationally scoped — for example, system-level analytics that help avoid regressions may be retained in aggregate. For customers requiring absolute separation we recommend Dedicated or Private deployment with contractual residency and an explicit carveout in the addendum.

Attached: redwood_dpa_addendum_draft.docx (contains redline and two alternative clauses: strict no-train vs. no-train-with-telemetry-exception). Please have your security team confirm which evidence items are mandatory so we can prioritize delivery.

Thanks,
